name: B10-0388/2025 (Renew) – Detention of EU citizens in the occupied areas of Cyprus
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the detention of EU citizens in the occupied areas of Cyprus
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the immediate release of five elderly Greek Cypriot EU citizens arrested in July 2025 while visiting land they own near Trikomo, in the Turkish-occupied north of Cyprus. They are being tried by an unrecognised military court. The Parliament also urges Turkey to give them medical care, investigate the detentions, and respect human rights. It condemns the detentions as intimidation linked to legal action over property development.

- The five detainees would be released and given medical care if Turkey acts.
- Turkey and the EU's member states, Council and Commission are asked to push for release.
- The Parliament asks the EU to weigh Turkey's rights record in future relations.
